title: Analysis of potential targets of 20S-protopanaxadiol on diabetic nephropathy based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation.
authors: Li, Chenfei; Ma, Chifa; Zhao, Ruxuan; Li, Xinfeng; Yu, Hengchi; Yuan, Mingxia
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究人参叶成分对糖尿病肾病的保护机制，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the protective effects and mechanisms of 20S-protopanaxadiol (PPD), a key component derived from ginseng folium, against diabetic nephropathy (DN). METHODS: Ingredients of ginseng folium were collected and screened using the TCMSP database. Therapeutic target genes for ginseng folium against DN were obtained, and protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks were constructed. Gene Ontology (GO) function and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichments were conducted on these targets. Furthermore, the results of network pharmacology were validated via molecular docking. Subsequently,the effects of PPD on TGF-beta1/Smads signaling pathway were assessed in db/db mice and HK-2 cells using biochemical assays and Western blotting. RESULTS: A total of 246 target genes for ginseng folium against DN were identified. KEGG analysis revealed significant enrichment in AGE-RAGE signaling in diabetic complications, PI3K-AKT, MAPK, and TNF pathways. PPD intragastric administration improved renal function in db/db mice and significantly reduced the expression of TGF-beta1, alpha-SMA, p-Smad3, and Smad4 in renal tissue (p < 0.05). Furthermore, PPD decreased the expression of TGF-beta1, p-Smad3, and Smad4 in high glucose-induced HK-2 cells. CONCLUSION: PPD potentially alleviates renal fibrosis in db/db mice and HK-2 cells by inhibiting the TGF-beta1/Smads pathway, thereby delaying DN progression.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨人参叶关键组分20S-原人参二醇（20S-protopanaxadiol, PPD）对糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy, DN）的保护作用及其机制。方法：利用TCMSP数据库收集并筛选人参叶成分，获取人参叶抗DN的治疗靶基因，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络，并对这些靶点进行基因本体（Gene Ontology, GO）功能和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）通路富集分析。此外，通过分子对接验证网络药理学结果。随后，采用生化检测和Western blotting评估PPD对db/db小鼠和HK-2细胞中TGF-beta1/Smads信号通路的影响。结果：共鉴定出246个人参叶抗DN的靶基因。KEGG分析显示，在糖尿病并发症的AGE-RAGE信号通路、PI3K-AKT、MAPK和TNF通路中显著富集。PPD灌胃给药改善了db/db小鼠的肾功能，并显著降低肾组织中TGF-beta1、alpha-SMA、p-Smad3和Smad4的表达（p < 0.05）。此外，PPD降低了高糖诱导的HK-2细胞中TGF-beta1、p-Smad3和Smad4的表达。结论：PPD可能通过抑制TGF-beta1/Smads通路减轻db/db小鼠和HK-2细胞的肾纤维化，从而延缓DN进展。
